archetypes.name: dyn-scope-gate
archetypes.rationale: Scope-disposition gates now span dispatch, ship, and PR mutation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new scope-disposition flow across dispatch_step2, dispatch_commit_route, dispatch_ship, pr.py, and scope_disposition.py. Check that coverage recomputation, stale disposition invalidation, and needs-user routing fail closed without blocking full-scope runs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
